subject.title: fix(opencode): sync Zen/Go static catalogs to live + models.dev

question: Before retiring `opencode/hy3-free`, should upgrades receive a plugin-owned Doctor recovery path, and what exact non-silent remediation should it apply or present?
rationale: The change intentionally invalidates persisted user model references, but selecting a paid Go model or one of several free Zen alternatives is a product choice that cannot safely be inferred by an automated repair.

options.title: Add Doctor recovery and manifest parity
options.body: Keep the static refresh, synchronize public manifest metadata, and add a plugin-owned Doctor repair or guided remediation for saved `opencode/hy3-free` references.

options.title: Keep the retired row temporarily
options.body: Defer removal until the desired upgrade remediation is defined, so existing saved selections remain usable during the transition.

options.title: Accept the breaking removal
options.body: Land the unknown-model behavior intentionally with explicit maintainer approval and user-facing migration documentation.

recommendation.title: Add Doctor recovery and manifest parity
recommendation.body: Keep the static refresh, synchronize public manifest metadata, and add a plugin-owned Doctor repair or guided remediation for saved `opencode/hy3-free` references.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the same OpenCode Go catalog makes this the strongest available area-routing signal, though the Zen upgrade-policy decision may need broader owner input.
